```{r}
assoc <- data.table::fread(file.path(reports_path, "gwas", "wm-gwas.gemma_GLs_filtered.assoc.txt"))

assoc$n <- 1:nrow(assoc)
```

```{r}
assoc2 <- assoc %>%
  mutate(
    chr = str_extract(rs, "^[^_:\\s]+"),   # first chunk e.g. "chr1"
    n   = row_number(),
    p_score_safe = pmax(p_score, 1e-300)
  )

```

```{r}
# recompute bonf 
bonf <- -log10(0.00005 / nrow(assoc2))

# prepare plot_df (only points above threshold)
plot_df <- assoc2 %>%
  mutate(chr = ifelse(is.na(chr) | chr == "", str_extract(rs, "^[^_:\\s]+"), chr)) %>%
  filter(!grepl("^scaffold", chr)) %>% 
  filter(-log10(p_score_safe) > 1) %>%
  mutate(
    n = as.integer(n),                            # ensure numeric
    chr = factor(chr, levels = unique(chr)),      # keep encountered order
    chr_idx = as.integer(chr),
    point_col = ifelse(chr_idx %% 2 == 1, "#5a798f", "#2a3740")
  )

# build axisdf: midpoint for each chr on the numeric n scale
axisdf <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(chr) %>%
  summarize(x = (min(n) + max(n)) / 2)  %>%
  ungroup()

# final plot: x = n (numeric), with custom breaks/labels from axisdf
manhattan_plot <-
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = n, y = -log10(p_score_safe))) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = point_col), width = 0.18, height = 0, size = 1.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = bonf, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = axisdf$x, labels = axisdf$chr, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = " ", y = expression(-log[10](p[score]))) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),                      # remove grid entirely
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, family = "roboto_condensed"),
    axis.title = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave(manhattan_plot,
      filename=file.path(figures_path, "manhattan_plot_GLs_filtered.png"),
      width=12,
      height=3)

```


```{r}
# prepare p-values (avoid 0)
qq_df <- assoc2 %>%
  mutate(pval = pmax(p_score_safe, 1e-300)) %>%
  arrange(pval) %>%
  mutate(
    observed = -log10(pval),
    expected = -log10(ppoints(n()))   # expected under Uniform(0,1)
  )

# make QQ plot
qq_plot <- ggplot(qq_df, aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, colour = "#5a798f") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, colour = "#2a3740", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = expression(Expected~~-log[10](italic(p))),
    y = expression(Observed~~-log[10](italic(p))),
    title = "QQ Plot of P-values"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, family = "roboto_condensed")
  )

ggsave(qq_plot,
      filename=file.path(figures_path, "qq_plot.png"),
      width=3,
      height=3)
```

Bayesian sparsed linear mixed model to check for major effect loci. Plot only non-zero effect loci.
```{r}
# Load hyperparameter file
hyp.params<-data.table::fread(file.path(reports_path, "gwas", "bslmm.hyp.txt"))

# Get mean, median, and 95% ETPI of hyperparameters
# pve -> proportion of phenotypic variance explained by the genotypes
pve<-c("PVE", mean(hyp.params$pve),quantile(hyp.params$pve, probs=c(0.5,0.025,0.975)))

# pge -> proportion of genetic variance explained by major effect loci
pge<-c("PGE",mean(hyp.params$pge),quantile(hyp.params$pge, probs=c(0.5,0.025,0.975)))

# pi -> proportion of variants with non-zero effects
pi<-c("pi",mean(hyp.params$pi),quantile(hyp.params$pi, probs=c(0.5,0.025,0.975)))

# n.gamma -> number of variants with major effect
n.gamma<-c("n.gamma",mean(hyp.params$n_gamma),quantile(hyp.params$n_gamma, probs=c(0.5,0.025,0.975)))

# get table of hyperparameters
hyp.params.table<-as.data.frame(rbind(pve,pge,pi,n.gamma),row.names=F)
colnames(hyp.params.table)<-c("hyperparam", "mean","median","2.5%", "97.5%")

# write table to file
write.table(hyp.params.table, 
            file=file.path(reports_path, 
            "gwas", 
            "hyperparameters.dsv"), 
            sep="\t", 
            quote=F)


```

```{r}
plot(hyp.params$pve, type="l", ylab="PVE", main="PVE - trace")
hist(hyp.params$pve, main="PVE - posterior distribution", xlab="PVE")
plot(density(hyp.params$pve), main="PVE - posterior distribution", xlab="PVE")
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r}
params<-data.table::fread(file.path(reports_path, "gwas", "bslmm.param.txt"))

# Get variants with sparse effect size on phenotypes 
# add sparse effect size (= beta * gamma) to data frame
params$"eff"<-abs(params$beta*params$gamma)

# get variants with effect size > 0
params.effects<-params[params$eff>0,]

# show number of variants with measurable effect
nrow(params.effects)

# sort by descending effect size
params.effects.sort<-params.effects[order(-params.effects$eff),]

# show top 10 variants with highest effect
head(params.effects.sort, 10) 

# variants with the highest sparse effects
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# top 1% variants (above 99% quantile)
top1<-params.effects.sort[params.effects.sort$eff>quantile(params.effects.sort$eff,0.99),]
# top 0.1% variants (above 99.9% quantile)
top01<-params.effects.sort[params.effects.sort$eff>quantile(params.effects.sort$eff,0.999),]
# top 0.01% variants (above 99.99% quantile)
top001<-params.effects.sort[params.effects.sort$eff>quantile(params.effects.sort$eff,0.9999),]
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ==============================================================================
# Get variants with high Posterior Inclusion Probability (PIP) == gamma
# ==============================================================================
# PIP is the frequency a variant is estimated to have a sparse effect in the MCMC

# sort variants by descending PIP
params.pipsort<-params[order(-params$gamma),]

# Show top 10 variants with highest PIP
head(params.pipsort,10)

# preferred chromosome order (change or extend if you need X/Y/MT etc.)
chr_order <- paste0("chr", 1:13)

plot_df_bslmm <- params %>%
  # extract chromosome like "chr5" and position (last integer in the rs string)
  mutate(
    chr = str_extract(rs, "chr[^_:\\s]+"),   # e.g. "chr5"
    pos = as.integer(str_extract(rs, "\\d+$"))  # last digits in string -> position
  ) %>%
  # force chr into the desired ordering (rows with chromosomes not in chr_order
  # will get NA and be placed after these when arranged)
  mutate(chr_factor = factor(chr, levels = chr_order)) %>%
  arrange(chr_factor, pos) %>%
  # continuous numbering across the whole dataset (1..N after arrange)
  mutate(n = row_number()) %>%
  select(-chr_factor) %>%
  mutate(
    n = as.integer(n),                            # ensure numeric
    chr = factor(chr, levels = unique(chr)),      # keep encountered order
    chr_idx = as.integer(chr),
    point_col = ifelse(chr_idx %% 2 == 1, "#5a798f", "#2a3740")
  )
```

```{r}
# ---- plotting ----

# build axisdf: midpoint for each chr on the numeric n scale
axisdf <- plot_df_bslmm %>%
  group_by(chr) %>%
  summarize(x = (min(n) + max(n)) / 2) %>%
  ungroup()

# sparse effect size, used for dot size
plot_df_bslmm$z <- plot_df_bslmm$eff
# log-transform to enhance visibility
plot_df_bslmm$z[plot_df_bslmm$z==0]<-0.00000000001
plot_df_bslmm$z<-1/abs(log(plot_df_bslmm$z))

manhattan_plot_bslmm <-
ggplot(plot_df_bslmm, aes(x = n, y =gamma, size=z)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = point_col), width = 0.18, height = 0, size = 1.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = axisdf$x, labels = axisdf$chr, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = " ", y = expression(-log[10](p[score]))) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),                      # remove grid entirely
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, family = "roboto_condensed"),
    axis.title = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave(manhattan_plot_bslmm,
      filename=file.path(figures_path, "manhattan_plot_GLs_bslmm.png"),
      width=12,
      height=3)
```

Check outliers and see if heterozygosity is associated with sex to explore mapping issues
```{r}
pheno <- read.table(file.path(data_path, "dfs", "pheno.txt"), header=T)
sex <- read.csv(file.path(data_path, "dfs", "sex.csv"), header=T)

gts <- read.table(file.path(reports_path, "gwas", "all_sites.tsv"), header=T) %>%
left_join(pheno, by="IID") %>% left_join(sex, by="IID")

gts_long <- gts %>%
    mutate(
    FID = sub("_.*", "", IID)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("chr"),
    names_to = "chr_pos",
    values_to = "genotype"
  )

# Keep only families with >1 genotype for this SNP
families_with_variation <- gts_long %>%
  filter(chr_pos == "chr10_9107590", genotype != "NA") %>%
  group_by(FID) %>%
  summarise(n_genotypes = n_distinct(genotype)) %>%
  filter(n_genotypes > 1) %>%
  pull(FID)

families_without_variation <- gts_long %>%
  filter(chr_pos == "chr10_9107590", genotype != "NA") %>%
  group_by(FID) %>%
  summarise(n_genotypes = n_distinct(genotype)) %>%
  filter(n_genotypes == 1) %>%
  pull(FID)

plot_effect_outliers_pheno_family <- 
  gts_long %>%
  filter(chr_pos == "chr10_9107590",
         genotype != "NA",
         FID %in% families_with_variation) %>%   # <-- keep only informative families
  mutate(genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("0/0", "0/1", "1/1"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genotype, y = hatch_date, color = genotype)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.01, height = 0, alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal, geom = "pointrange", 
               color = "black", size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0/0" = "#60a0d1",
                                "0/1" = "#d1be60",
                                "1/1" = "#e6584e")) +
  facet_wrap(~ FID, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Roboto Condensed") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 11)) +
  labs(x = "\nGenotype\n",
       y = "\nHatching date\n",
       title = "Top SNP: chr10_9107590 (families with >1 genotype)",
       subtitle = "Faceted by family (FID)")

ggsave(plot_effect_outliers_pheno_family,
      filename = file.path(figures_path, "plot_effect_outliers_pheno_family.png"),
      width = 10,
      height = 26)

plot_effect_outliers_sex_family <-
```

Plot a single SNP and show family variation
```{r}
# 1) pick ONE SNP (most frequent on chr10, excluding missing)
one_snp <- gts_long %>%
  filter(genotype != "./.") %>%
  separate(chr_pos, into = c("chr", "pos"), sep = "_", convert = TRUE, remove = FALSE) %>%
  filter(chr == "chr10") %>%
  count(chr_pos) %>%
  filter(chr_pos == "chr10_9107590") %>%
  pull(chr_pos)

one_snp
# e.g. "chr10_9107590"

subset_families <- gts_long %>%
  filter(genotype != "./.") %>%
  separate(chr_pos, into = c("chr", "pos"), sep = "_", convert = TRUE, remove = FALSE) %>%
  filter(chr_pos == one_snp) %>%
  mutate(genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("0/0", "0/1", "1/1"))) %>%
  group_by(FID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(genotype, na.rm = TRUE) > 1) %>%   # <-- key change
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(FID!="F57" & FID!="F69" & FID!="F157" & FID!="F180" & FID!="F110" & FID!="F144" & FID!="F67" & FID!="F38" & FID!="F167" & FID!="F23")


# 2) plot by family (FID)
plot_one_snp_by_fid_var1 <- subset_families %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genotype, y = hatch_date, color = genotype)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_cl_normal,
               geom = "pointrange",
               color = "black",
               size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0/0" = "#60a0d1",
                                "0/1" = "#d1be60",
                                "1/1" = "#e6584e")) +
  facet_wrap(~ FID, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position="none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Top SNP:", one_snp),
    x = "\nGenotype\n",
    y = "\nHatching date\n"
  )

plot_one_snp_by_fid_var1

ggsave(plot_one_snp_by_fid_var1,
      filename=file.path(figures_path, "one_snp_by_fid_var.png"),
      width=6,
      height=7)
```

Tile plot
```{r}
# 1. encode genotypes as numeric (0,1,2)
gts_enc <- gts_long %>%
  mutate(gt_code = case_when(
    genotype == "0/0" ~ 0,
    genotype == "0/1" ~ 1,
    genotype == "1/1" ~ 2,
    TRUE              ~ NA_real_
  ))


# 2. wide matrix: rows = IID, cols = chr_pos
mat <- gts_enc %>%
  dplyr::select(IID, chr_pos, gt_code) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = chr_pos, values_from = gt_code) %>%
  arrange(IID)

# keep IID separately then make numeric matrix
iids <- mat$IID
nummat <- mat %>% dplyr::select(-IID) %>% as.matrix()

# 3. Handle NAs: replace column-wise with column mean (other options noted below)
col_means <- colMeans(nummat, na.rm = TRUE)
# If a column is all NA, replace NA mean with 0
col_means[is.na(col_means)] <- 0
# replace NAs
for (j in seq_len(ncol(nummat))) {
  nas <- is.na(nummat[, j])
  if (any(nas)) nummat[nas, j] <- col_means[j]
}

# 4. distance and clustering
d <- dist(nummat, method = "euclidean")    # other methods possible
hc <- hclust(d, method = "average")        # try "ward.D2" too
iid_order <- iids[hc$order]

# 5. set factor order in original long dataframe and plot
gts_long_ord <- gts_enc %>%
  separate(chr_pos, into = c("chr", "pos"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    pos = as.numeric(pos),
    chr = factor(chr, levels = gtools::mixedsort(unique(chr)))  # or sort(unique(chr))
  ) %>%
  arrange(chr, pos) %>%
  mutate(
    chr_pos = factor(chr_pos, levels = unique(chr_pos)),
    IID = factor(IID, levels = iid_order)
  )

ggplot(gts_long_ord, aes(x = chr_pos, y = IID, fill = genotype)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey70") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0/0" = "#67a9c7", "0/1" = "#cc5135", "1/1" = "#d4c146")) +
  labs(x = "\nLocus (chr_pos)", y = "\nIndividual", fill = "Genotype") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),                      
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, angle=45, family = "roboto_condensed"),
    axis.title = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

```
